inputs: All inputs are stored in each npz as float32; float64 Harmonica evaluates exactly those rounded values. ENU metres, A/m, unit inducing direction; outputs nT.

cases.single: 24 seeded outside points, one asymmetric magnetized prism
cases.translated: same geometry translated by (100000,-200000,50000) m, with float32 quantization
cases.multiple: three unequal prisms, mixed magnetization, 24 points
cases.far: axis and oblique points at approximately 8, 10, 12 maximum prism widths from center

FAR_REL: proposed far-field float32 corner cancellation bound
CROSS_NEAR_REL: two near-field errors may have opposite signs
CROSS_FAR_REL: two far-field errors may have opposite signs
ZERO_ABS_NT: absolute floor for zero and cancellation
